Madurai Police Ban Drones Over Thirupparankundram Hill During Karthigai Deepam

Madurai police have banned the use of drones over Thirupparankundram hill during the Karthigai Deepam festival. The Tamil Nadu government has also sought a review from the Supreme Court regarding an order that permitted the festival to be held at the Thiruparankundram Hill Pillar. Reports indicate a debate surrounding legal and communal issues related to the lighting of lamps during Karthigai Deepam in Tamil Nadu.
